OUR STORY

Replacing Morning Phone Chases with Procurement Clarity

Pharmaceutical procurement can still mean repeated calls to check stock, compare schemes and ask about expiry dates. Distributors, in turn, may manage catalogue updates and enquiries across separate channels.

We built ConnectPharma to bring supplier listings, product details and buyer enquiries into one B2B marketplace for Tamil Nadu. Buyers can compare information provided by suppliers and contact them directly; both sides remain responsible for confirming stock, price, product details and lawful transaction terms.

THE MARKETPLACE, BUILT AROUND CLARITY

What Sets ConnectPharma Apart

Useful discovery and comparison tools, with transparent limits on what the platform verifies or guarantees.

Business documents, reviewed manually

Retailers and distributors can submit licence and GST documents for administrative review. This is not an independent government-registry check and does not certify a business’s legal status.

Supplier-provided rates and schemes

Catalogue listings may include PTR, PTS, GST and scheme information for comparison. Figures can be indicative or sample data; confirm the current price and terms directly.

Batch and expiry details where available

Supplier catalogues can include batch, expiry and stock fields. These details are supplier-entered; the marketplace does not independently validate them or monitor cold-chain handling.

Designed for Tamil Nadu businesses

Explore supplier locations and delivery details where provided. Dispatch coordination, delivery commitments and any invoicing arrangements must be confirmed with the supplier.

WHO WE SERVE

Built for Business-to-Business Connections

Retail Pharmacies & Medical Shops

Search medicine listings, compare available supplier details and send an enquiry to confirm stock, pricing and terms.

Hospitals, Clinics & Nursing Homes

Institutional teams can explore available supplier information and contact us about account fit. Dedicated hospital procurement workflows are not currently available.

Wholesale Distributors

Maintain a digital catalogue, share product and batch details, receive enquiries from retailer accounts and respond through the supplier portal.

B2B USE • BUSINESS RESPONSIBILITIES

Regulatory responsibility stays with every business

ConnectPharma is intended for business-to-business use. Email verification confirms access to an email address; it does not verify a Drug Licence, GST registration, pharmacist credential or business identity. Documents submitted for manual administrative review are not independently checked against government registries and do not guarantee legal validity, completeness or current status. Buyers and suppliers must confirm each other’s authorisations and comply with the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, applicable rules and other legal requirements. The platform does not offer direct-to-consumer retail sales or generate GST invoices.
